metadata.source_file: Command Systems/Segment Level/1.04.01.01.28 - CS_SW Program Management PM.docx

data.leadership_messages: The addition of work packages will do well to bolster the Control accountIs this account for software for the related hardware? Or is a software account managing hardware work packages?
data.rationale: The work necessary to maintain SW elements defined in this control account is reassuring. The addition of associated work packages will solidify the accounts intent.

areas.text: Which hardware-related work packages will be linked to this account? The work needed has been identified, but the work that needs support has not.
The IMS loading could be bolstered by indicating the related WP’s. Schedule and planning can be assessed when the appropriate discrete tasks have been identified
Without the identification of the specific discrete tasks this LOE account supports, it is impossible to accurately assess the cross-functional integration of this account.

data.products: SOW Rev 9.0, NG Command Systems Control Account Rollup/COBRA Exports 31 July 2026, WBS Dictionary 6 Aug 2026, IMP Rev B, NG RAM 6 Aug 2026
data.strengths: Identifying all of the supporting work and the general areas that will be supported is a helpful start, when the related Work packages are identified, the planning portions should be straight forward.
data.concerns: Concern: The Scope of this account does seem large, though not unmanageable.
data.questions: This Control account mentions it will supply the management for related hardware packages. Does this mean the Control account is managing Software accounts for a given hardware?
